```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(table1)
```

```{r}
df = read.csv("../Data/metadata.csv")
df$is_patient = as.factor(df$is_patient)
df = df[df$time == 1 & !is.na(df$pain_avg), ]

T1 = table1(
  ~ gender + 
    age + 
    weight + 
    ethnicity + 
    employment_status + 
    pain_avg + 
    promis_dep + 
    promis_anger + 
    promis_anxiety + promis_sleep + 
    alcohol + 
    opioid + 
    exercise + 
    current_opioid_use | is_patient, data=df,
       render.continuous=c( .="Median [Min, Max]"))
```


```{r}
T1
```
